item1.question: Which brands does Ati Abzar Pishro officially represent?
item1.answer: Ati Abzar Pishro is the official representative of KORLOY, a leading South Korean brand, providing advanced cutting tools and machining solutions directly to the Iranian market.

item2.question: How can I get expert consultation for selecting the right cutting tools?
item2.answer: You can contact our technical team by phone or submit a consultation request through our website. Our experts will analyze your machining requirements and recommend the most suitable tools and solutions.

item3.question: Do your products come with warranty and after-sales support?
item3.answer: Yes, all products supplied by Ati Abzar Pishro come with comprehensive after-sales service and technical support. Our support team is always ready to assist you with any issues or technical inquiries.

item4.question: Is it possible to arrange training courses or seminars at our facility?
item4.answer: Absolutely. We offer professional training courses and industrial seminars both onsite at your facility and online. Please get in touch with our training department to schedule a session tailored to your needs.

item5.question: What are the available channels to place an order?
item5.answer: You can place your orders by phone, email, or through the online order form on our website. Our sales representatives are also available to assist you with your purchase.

item6.question: Do you provide small-quantity orders for smaller workshops?
item6.answer: Yes, we cater to the needs of both large industrial clients and small to medium-sized workshops, offering flexible order volumes to suit your requirements.

item7.question: How can I stay updated on your latest courses and seminars?
item7.answer: By subscribing to our newsletter and following our social media channels, you will receive timely updates about upcoming training programs, technical seminars, and new developments.

item8.question: How can I stay informed about the latest KORLOY products and machining technologies?
item8.answer: We regularly share the latest innovations, cutting-edge tools, and machining technologies from KORLOY through our website, social media platforms, newsletters, and specialized seminars. Stay connected with us to keep your operations at the forefront of the industry.
